tailoring.headline: Senior SAP CX Consultant | SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & Techno-Functional Specialist
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams. Works in a techno-functional role between business and IT.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior SAP CX Consultant
cover_en.hook: Solvia Digital Solutions stands out for its exceptional delivery of digital commerce transformations, making this Senior SAP CX Consultant role an ideal match for my background. Over the past 5+ years, I have engineered and delivered enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell Automation and Shell, bridging business requirements and technical execution.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management for global enterprise channels.

bullets.label: Complex Integrations & APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub to synchronize product catalogs seamlessly across ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Served as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams by analysing requirements, writing user stories and functional specifications, and translating them into scalable SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Enterprise Delivery & DevOps
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2), performed database query refactoring for optimal performance, and supported agile delivery within international teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my SAP CX and commerce expertise can contribute to Solvia Digital Solutions.

tailoring.why_company: Solvia Digital Solutions' commitment to delivering high-performance digital commerce transformations aligns perfectly with my deep expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud. I want to bring my 5+ years of techno-functional experience from Rockwell Automation and Shell to help Solvia drive successful, complex enterprise implementations for your clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, robust Java/Spring backend skills, and proven techno-functional consulting experience to deliver impactful enterprise solutions at Solvia Digital Solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. With strong techno-functional expertise in integrations, OCC APIs, and SAP CX, I would love to contribute to Solvia Digital Solutions. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior SAP CX Consultant – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the Senior SAP CX Consultant position at Solvia Digital Solutions. With over 5 years of hands-on experience in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and enterprise integrations across Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong techno-functional capabilities to bridge business needs and technical delivery.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, and am available starting 16 December 2026. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
